brief:
Palestinians may learn of a poll postponement before seeing the final list of election candidates, according to Shehab Wire. The trajectory toward a postponement decree appears shorter than the path to the ballot box, based on available data.

The observation reflects deepening uncertainty over the electoral process, with institutional obstacles potentially derailing the vote before voters even know who is running.
dek: Palestinians may learn of a poll postponement before seeing the final list of election candidates, according to Shehab Wire.
title: Palestinian elections postponed before candidates announced
